improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
improve.coach: It's come up in 54% of your matches, but only 40% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Shot selection
tips: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
improve.coach: Flagged 31% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football. 62% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: The keeper's arms are probably still sore. Shows up in 62% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet. 54% of the time. Teammates can count on it.
